notes: Independently read all 14 eligible production TypeScript files and both metadata files at the pinned source commit. All 32 files beneath the plugin root are partitioned into 16 reviewed and 16 excluded records. No Inspector implementation, helpers, output, other plugin fixtures, or expectation extractor was consulted.

No plugin-local relative import leaves extensions/logbook. index.ts dynamically imports src/node-host.ts and selects the shipped src/store.worker entrypoint using runtimeSource; package.json explicitly declares src/store.worker.ts in openclaw.build.workerEntries. Both modules and all their local production dependencies are included. SDK facade imports are boundaries, not recursively audited plugin-owned shared source.

Public SDK identities were checked against package.json exports and the corresponding src/plugin-sdk facades. Imported names remain the public exported names even where the facade itself forwards an internal implementation. No installed dependency implementation contributes findings.

api is explicitly OpenClawPluginApi. index.ts passes api.runtime to LogbookService, whose deps.runtime has type NonNullable<OpenClawPluginApi["runtime"]>; the only concrete consumed runtime paths are nodes.list, nodes.invoke, mediaUnderstanding.extractStructuredWithModel and llm.complete. Bare runtime propagation and the root indexed type do not create api.runtime or runtime-root identities.

The service callback ctx.config/logger/scheduler/stateDir, policy callback ctx.config/invokeNode, Gateway handler params/respond, and the separately typed fullConfig/logger/scheduler fields are context values, not aliases of OpenClawPluginApi or PluginRuntime. Their member accesses do not become API/runtime findings.

SDK function results (SQLite stores, Kysely query builders, prepared statements, WAL maintenance, and singleton state) and the KeyedAsyncQueue instance are not public API/runtime handles. Calls inside known SDK helpers are not inferred. Wrapper calls registerRead/registerWrite retain only their actual api.registerGatewayMethod body dependencies.

configureSqliteConnectionPragmas is mixed because an ordinary value import and call coexist with explicit ReturnType<typeof ...> type references. getNodeSqliteKysely is mixed because the worker imports/calls its value and store-frame-queries imports it with type syntax and uses typeof. Later type usage alone does not change a module import classification.

No API on/registerHook calls or manifest channels/providers/skills/commandAliases/cliCommands/contracts fields occur. uiCapabilities, categories, activation, uiHints, configGroups and configSchema are metadata outside the agreed manifest-contract identity set. Runtime node-command and gateway-method strings are not fabricated manifest contracts or named hooks.

The ambiguous sqlite-backend-entrypoint.test-support.ts was read and its callers verified: only .test.ts modules and Vitest build/declaration tooling use it. It is excluded as test-helper; all production store and worker files are included. Production source under extensions/logbook matches the pinned commit.
